    Private catamaran or yacht

    Charter the whole boat just for your group and sail the Puerto Plata coast. Choose from 4 catamarans and 2 yachts.

    Boats leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taino Bay. Transport is not included: we’ll quote it separately on WhatsApp or by email.

    Viking 48' Yacht

    Sport-fishing yacht with a flybridge: the upper deck has the best views. Below there’s a lounge, 2 cabins and 2 bathrooms, and the aft deck is the party zone.

    • 3–4 hours

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What every cruise passenger asks before booking.

We pick you up at the Puerto Plata cruise port and bring you back when the tour ends. Round-trip transport is included, except for catamarans and yachts: they leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taino Bay, and we’ll quote that transport separately on WhatsApp or by email.

We plan every tour around your ship’s departure time. When you book, tell us your ship’s name and your all-aboard time.

The price per person depends on how many of you travel together: 1 to 5, 6 to 14 or 15 to 50 people. The bigger the group, the less each person pays. Catamarans and yachts work differently: you charter the whole boat for a flat price for up to 15 or 20 people, depending on the boat, and each additional person costs extra.

Round-trip transport, water along the way and a buffet lunch at the waterfalls’ restaurant. The zipline is optional.

No. At the end of the tour you get free time at Playa Dorada, where you can have lunch at one of the beachfront restaurants if you like. Lunch and extra drinks are not included.

English and Spanish. Message us on WhatsApp in whichever you prefer.

Cancel 10 or more days before your tour and we refund 100% of what you paid; with less than 10 days’ notice, we refund 50%. If your cruise ship doesn’t reach Puerto Plata, we refund 90%.
